prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ summarizeSensors }`. The function accepts an array of readings shaped as `{ zone, value }`, where `zone` is a non-empty string and `value` is a finite number. Throw `TypeError` if the argument is not an array or any reading is malformed. Return an object whose keys are zones and whose values are `{ count, minimum, maximum, average }`. Zones must be inserted into the result in first-seen order. An empty input returns an empty plain object. Treat `-0` as `0` in every reported numeric field. Do not mutate the input or retain aliases to its objects.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
